page_title: GIR 1-2 CEL | Girona v Celta Vigo 01/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Beek D. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+3' Vitor Reis (Girona) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' That's a clear yellow card. Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) goes into the book.
89' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) attempts to delay the restart of play. The referee doesn't like it.
89' Arnau Martinez (Girona) gets a yellow card.
89' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Arnau Martinez (Girona). Celta Vigo win a free kick.
85' The referee signals a substitution. Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) is brought on as a substitute for Oscar Mingueza.
85' Here is a change. Carlos Dominguez is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Manuel Fernandez (Celta Vigo).
84' Arnau Martinez (Girona) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
81' Miguel Ortiz shows a yellow card to Claudio Echeverri (Girona) for his blatant foul.
81' Substitution. Hugo Rincon walks off the pitch and Joel Roca (Girona) comes on as a substitute.
80' Girona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

80' Claudio Echeverri (Girona) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper! Girona will take a corner kick.
80' A quickly taken corner by Girona.

79' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the right side of the goal, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Ionut Radu. The ball is out of play and Girona manage to earn a corner.
78' Claudio Echeverri (Girona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Miguel Ortiz signals. A free kick has been awarded to Celta Vigo.

76' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
73' Michel has decided to substitute Axel Witsel and he is replaced by Claudio Echeverri (Girona).
73' The substitution has been made. Abel Ruiz (Girona) has replaced Vladyslav Vanat.
73' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) replaces Fernando Lopez.
73' Here's the change. Ferran Jutgla leaves the pitch and Andres Antanon (Celta Vigo) comes on as a substitute.
73' Miguel Ortiz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Daley Blind (Girona). A free kick is awarded to Celta Vigo.
70' 1 - 2 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Vitor Reis (Girona), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the top right corner of his own goal.
68' Girona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

67' Ivan Martin (Girona) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

65' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Girona, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
65' Problems for Michel as Bryan Gil (Girona) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Ivan Martin replaces him.
64' Substitution. Thomas Lemar makes his way off the pitch and Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) comes on as his replacement.
63' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Paulo Gazzaniga to dive and make a save.
62' A clumsy foul by Daley Blind (Girona) and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle. Free kick. Celta Vigo will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
62' The attendance for today's match is 11371.

61' Daley Blind (Girona) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
60' Girona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

60' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Hugo Rincon (Girona) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Ionut Radu pulls off a brilliant save. It will be a corner kick for Girona.
59' A substitution has been made. Hugo Alvarez goes off and Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) comes on.

58' 1 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Oscar Mingueza, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo), who beats Paulo Gazzaniga with a brilliant shot into the top of the net. 1:1.
57' Arnau Martinez (Girona) is flagged for offside.
57' Poor challenge! Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) is penalised for tripping and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle. Girona will take a free kick.
54' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) heads on.
53' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
53' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Girona are awarded a corner kick.

52' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Joseph Aidoo (Celta Vigo). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the crossbar and is cleared to safety. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
49' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul. Girona have a free kick.
47' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Miguel Ortiz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Arnau Martinez (Girona) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) accepts a pass deep inside the box and after a nice touch sends the ball towards the bottom right corner. It is a pretty sweet shot, but one of the defenders changes the trajectory of the ball and deflects it onto the post. What an unlucky moment for Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo). He must have smashed a mirror recently.
42' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Ortiz had an easy-decision to make.

39' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Paulo Gazzaniga is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
39' Celta Vigo are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
35' 1 - 0 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Axel Witsel knock down. 1:0.
35' The referee signals a corner kick to Girona.
34' Bryan Gil (Girona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Girona have a corner.
34' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
32' A corner kick by Celta Vigo is thwarted by the well prepared Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona).

32' A pass travels right across the box to Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper inside the left post, but Paulo Gazzaniga denies him with a decent save. Good work from Celta Vigo as they win a corner.

31' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
31' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
30' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo). The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Celta Vigo.

29' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) reacts well to meet the lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but sends a weak header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
27' Celta Vigo fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
27' A corner kick by Celta Vigo is thwarted by the well prepared Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona). The ball goes out of play. Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.

24' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Ionut Radu shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
23' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Girona.
21' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball has crossed the sideline. Girona are taking a throw-in.

17' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) receives a pass on the edge of the box and attempts a lob as the keeper is off his line, but the effort crashes off the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
17' Celta Vigo take a short corner kick.
16' Celta Vigo fail to score from a corner as Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) leaps to collect the ball.
14' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' Axel Witsel (Girona) tackles a bit over-zealously and Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul. Celta Vigo have a free kick.
9' The resulting corner from Thomas Lemar (Girona) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
9' Bryan Gil (Girona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Girona are going to take it.
4' The linesman raises his flag. Arnau Martinez (Girona) is adjudged offside.
4' Girona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
4' Bryan Gil (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Girona win a corner.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Celta Vigo will kick the game off.
Miguel Ortiz got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
